question: Which of the following Biosphere reserves is located in Uttarakhand?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Nanda Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve** is located in the state of **Uttarakhand**, India.
 
• This biosphere reserve is centered around the **Nanda Devi National Park**, which is a UNESCO **World Heritage Site**.
 
• The reserve is known for its **rich biodiversity** and includes a variety of **flora and fauna**, many of which are endemic to the region.
 
• The geographical area of the reserve is characterized by **steep mountain peaks**, deep valleys, and glaciers, including the famous **Nanda Devi Peak**.
 
• The reserve is part of the **Western Himalayan biogeographical zone**, which is crucial for the conservation of various endangered species.
 
• It is home to species such as the **snow leopard**, **Himalayan musk deer**, and various high-altitude plants.
 
• The **Government of India** designated Nanda Devi as a biosphere reserve under its **Man and Biosphere Programme** initiated by UNESCO.
 
• This reserve also plays a significant role in preserving the **cultural heritage** of the indigenous communities residing in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Panchmarhi Biosphere Reserve**__

 __
 
• **Panchmarhi Biosphere Reserve** is located in **Madhya Pradesh**, India.
 
• It is known for its **unique landscapes** and diverse ecosystems, including forests, waterfalls, and caves.
 
• This reserve includes the **Satpura National Park**, **Bori Wildlife Sanctuary**, and **Panchmarhi Sanctuary**.
 
• The region is rich in **flora and fauna**, including species like leopards, Indian bison, and various birds.
 
 
 
• **Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve**__
 __
 
• The **Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve** spans the states of **Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala** in southern India.
 
• It is part of the **Western Ghats**, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• The reserve is known for its **high biodiversity** and is home to species like the **Nilgiri Tahr** and **Lion-tailed Macaque**.
 
• It includes protected areas such as the **Bandipur National Park**, **Mudumalai Wildlife Sanctuary**, and **Silent Valley National Park**.
 
 
 
• **Dihang-Dibang Biosphere Reserve**__
 
 
• **Dihang-Dibang Biosphere Reserve** is situated in the state of **Arunachal Pradesh**, India.
 
• The reserve is named after the **Dihang and Dibang rivers** that flow through the region.
 
• It is known for its **pristine wilderness** and includes dense forests, high-altitude meadows, and diverse wildlife.
 
• Rare species such as the **red panda** and **Mishmi takin** are found here.
